caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented object that appears to be a metal door handle with an elongated, curved grip. The handle is attached to two symmetrical mounting plates, one at the top and one at the bottom. Both plates are dark in color, probably drawn with black or dark gray, and have an ornate, pointed design with teardrop and spike-like shapes at the ends. Each plate contains three screw holes, and the top plate features a small keyhole. The handle itself is cylindrical and smoothly curved, connecting the two plates. The background of the image is plain and light-colored, likely beige or off-white, providing contrast to the dark object, and there are no additional items or decorations in the drawing.
title: Door Handle
